index.title: Dispatcher assignments
index.subtitle: What each dispatcher is responsible for. This is what they can see.
index.explainer: A dispatcher only sees the loads, carriers, equipment, drivers and expenses assigned here. With nothing assigned they sign in with all their permissions and every list comes back empty — which looks like a fault, and is not one.
index.noDispatchers: No dispatchers yet. Invite one from Users.
index.nothingAssigned: Nothing assigned. This person sees empty lists.
index.noneLeft: Nothing left to assign of this type.

groups.title: Groups
groups.hint: A bag of carriers, trucks, trailers and drivers. Assigning the group to a dispatcher grants everything inside it at once — and turning the group off takes it back from everyone who has it.
groups.name: Name
groups.empty: This group is empty, so it grants nothing.
groups.inactive: Turned off: it grants nothing to anyone right now.

errors.notADispatcher: That person is not a dispatcher in your company.
errors.resourceNotFound: That does not exist or is not yours.
errors.alreadyAssigned: That dispatcher already has this assigned.
errors.groupExists: There is already a group with that name.

flash.ended: Assignment ended. Their access changes the next time they sign in.
flash.commissionSaved: Commission saved. It applies to new loads — the ones already agreed keep the percentage frozen on them.
flash.groupOff: Group turned off. It no longer grants anything.
